requirements.title: Self-serve bring-your-own model import
requirements.description: A guided import flow (inspect → confirm → install) over CLI + RPC + UI accepts a Hugging Face repo id (gold path), direct URL, or local path; auto-detects single-file vs diffusers-repo layout (routed to Assets[] vs Repo); fetches metadata and infers the architecture (returning confidence + evidence) for the user to confirm; reads license / NSFW; installs via the shared internal/fetch spine with a pinned checksum; and registers add-only at local tier with a user-imported provenance label. Public/BYOK serving of an unverified-license import is refused unless commercial rights are attested (D4). The imported model immediately offers its native + proven-derived ops.

validation.notes: HF metadata seam (fake + recorded fixture) feeding architecture inference + layout detection.
InferArchitecture pipeline-class/tag → Architecture table with confidence + evidence; ambiguous/unknown returns low confidence (never silently guessed).
ProposeImport / BuildImportEntry layout→backend routing, provenance label, local-tier + commercial-attestation gate; add-only enforcement.
Shared download / HF snapshot / checksum-pin / artifact-kind validation spine reused by models + adapters import.
Import wizard states (inspect → preview detected metadata → confirm architecture/license → install with progress).

requirements.title: Attended GPU E2E — import an HF base by repo id
requirements.description: Import a real SD1.5/SDXL checkpoint by HF repo id → confirm the inferred architecture → install → ai generate at 512px → non-empty output; verify the import offers its derived img2img + inpaint. Proven via `make gpu-e2e-import` (IMAGE_TOOLS_E2E_IMPORT_REPO=<repo>); skips gracefully off-GPU and is excluded from the default test run.

validation.notes: Attended GPU run PROVEN on this host: imported Lykon/dreamshaper-8 by HF repo id → architecture inferred sd15 → installed (diffusers) → `ai generate` @512 real output → derived image_to_image offered. `make gpu-e2e-import` (idempotent regression guard, set IMAGE_TOOLS_E2E_IMPORT_REPO/_ID).
